core_categories: Medical Devices; Diagnostic Instruments; Cardiovascular Diagnostics; Physiological Monitoring; Maternal-Fetal Care; Veterinary Monitoring
specialty_focus: Shenzhen Biocare Bio-Medical Equipment is a manufacturer of medical diagnostic instruments, specializing in cardiovascular diagnostics, physiological monitoring, and maternal-fetal care. It develops and globally distributes clinical electronic equipment such as ECG, Holter monitors, patient monitors, fetal monitors, ultrasound systems, and infusion pumps. The company also offers a veterinary monitoring series and has a large distribution network with over 2000 distributors.
